scope: Frozen native CORE5 account/scheduler integration with generated completed-bar fixtures. No historical, live venue, recovery or fork certification.
review_method: Independent source and preserved-receipt review; no tests rerun, market data read or source edits during review.
semantic_findings: Signal prices and all covariance constituents are source-bound and available by signal; np.diff(close)/close[:-1], sample ddof=1 and annualization times 365 match the frozen original formula.

Each positive-lot native increase refreshes independent charged actual/pending corners after prior native fills and funding, using current available opens and remaining capacity. Original gross 0.60, asset 0.30 and annual volatility 0.10 checks remain unchanged.

No live preview charges, fabricated fills, funding replay or double debit found. The actual native fill method is called once after approval; separate native and guard capacity ledgers track the same executed quantities.
Fixed lambda grid 1, 0.75, 0.50, 0.25, 0 and exact valid lambda-1 raw-target dispatch remain frozen. Native floor dust stays pending; genuine capacity partials and native refusals fail closed.
Native reductions precede increases and consume shared symbol capacity, including sign flips. Priority reductions and terminal exits preserve paid native fills and native retry/expiry bookkeeping.
Guard exceptions reject or abort before actual execution; account/pending mutation detection aborts and finally restores the prior execute_fill binding.

Baseline parity compares real native trades, exact account state, pending orders and full simulator snapshots. Gap, funding-tie, changed-pending, capacity-shrink, independent-corner and shared-capacity regressions are substantive.
remaining_limits: A historical provider and its real publication clocks, source price consistency, complete daily calendars and preceding-minute quote provenance have not been validated or connected by this review.

The completed-bar provider requires a complete ordered CORE5 daily source calendar at an exact daily decision; the generated integration is not a certification of historical eligibility or gap behavior.
Direct attempt calls rely on native caller ownership of funding-before-fill event ordering. The installed native advance_day path is covered by the generated integration fixture.
Approval applies to the frozen native account/scheduler semantics, not arbitrary custom account monkeypatches, recovery/fork persistence, live venue filters or production deployment.
This is an increase-admission guard, not a guarantee of continuously capped portfolio volatility: mandatory native reductions can remove a hedge and increase sigma.
source_references: Frozen dependency manifest entries for terminal_adapter.py, resumable_perpetual.py, public_sma_perpetual.py and quant/perpetual_account.py
